name: Dark Prison Haunted House
address: 3301 E 5th St, Carson City, NV 89701, USA
photo_attributions: Photo by kinzie rose hunter via Google Maps; Photo by Leon Vieira via Google Maps; Photo by Jon Fish via Google Maps
activities: Cellblock C haunted house; Unit 15 haunted house; Institute for the Unwell haunted house; Photo ops; Carnival games; Live DJ; Projection mapping; Bar (The Shiv Bar); Food trucks; Gift shop; Behind the Screams tour (special event); Flashlight Night (special event); Live actors; Trivia
extra_notes: Timed ticketed event with extremely limited time slots that usually sell out every night. VIP experience available with additional benefits (priority seating, VIP bar/lounge access, 20-minute behind-the-scenes tour, 1 free drink, commemorative gift). Children under 5 not permitted; not recommended for children 12 and under without adult supervision. Not recommended for people with epilepsy, asthma, heart issues, or pregnant women. Dense fog, haze, loud noises, and strobe lights used. No costumes or face-covering masks allowed. No-touch policy with actors. Metal detectors and security screening required. Free parking (3 lots). Partially wheelchair accessible with some limitations. Sign waiver required before arrival. VIP tickets sell out well before General Admission.
